name: sit_ground
text: A person sits down on the ground from standing. Bend the knees into a squat, lower the hips onto the floor, and extend both legs comfortably forward with knees slightly bent. Place hands beside the hips for balance. End seated on the ground with upright torso, not lying down.
repair: Preserve body timing and pose; horizontal finger direction for low hands. Regenerate, never edit final motion arrays.

review.notes_zh: 从站立屈膝坐到地上，两手向后撑地、膝盖弯曲；已修正低手姿态避免手指大幅穿地，最低关节点约-1.8厘米。
